# repaper

> repaper is a Telegram bot that turns your entire information feed into a clean, noise-free AI summary — take back your attention from endless scrolling.

## Features

- 4 summary presets: brief, digest, detailed, and narrative formats
- Custom prompts & interests: tailor the AI to highlight what matters to you
- 4 output languages: English, Russian, Belarusian, and Polish
- Scheduled digests: automatic summaries delivered on a timer inside Telegram

## Links

- [Launch Bot](https://t.me/repaperbot): Try repaper directly in Telegram
- [Roadmap](https://repaper.is-a.bot/roadmap): What's coming next for repaper
